recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2).
2. Draw the slide frame: a thin dark-red (#C00000) rectangle outline around the entire slide edge, no fill.
3. Place the title centered at the top (occupying roughly 5-15% of slide height): bold sans-serif text, the largest on the slide, reading 'Assignment #2: Part 1 - Prediction', with 'Assignment #2:' in red (#C00000) and 'Part 1 - Prediction' in blue (#0000CC).
4. Place the slide-number badge at the top-right corner: a small yellow (#FFFF99) filled circle containing black text '36'.
5. Place the instructions box in the upper-middle: a white-filled rectangle with a thin blue (#0000CC) border, spanning ~80% of slide width (~10% to ~90% horizontally) and ~18% to ~55% of slide height.
6. Inside the instructions box, place instruction line 1 (top line) as regular-weight black (#000000) sans-serif text; in all four instruction lines, color the standalone variable letters x and y red (#C00000). Line 1 text: '[1] Define any linear equation of one variable (e.g. y = 3x+2)'.
7. Place instruction line 2 directly below line 1 in the same style: '[2] Select 5 different values for x (x1, x2,… x10) and calculate corresponding y values'.
8. Place instruction line 3 directly below line 2 in the same style: '[3] Use x and y values as training data , apply MSSE technique to obtain the equation of the line that best fit on the training data (compare to your defined equation)'.
9. Place instruction line 4 directly below line 3 in the same style: '[4] Repeat 1,2, and 3 after adding random noise term to the equation (e.g. y = 3x+2 + random(0..1)'.
10. Place the left scatter plot in the bottom-left (~15-45% width, ~58-95% height): a white square with a thin red (#C00000) border; inside draw red (#C00000) L-shaped axes (vertical axis on the left, horizontal axis along the bottom, meeting at the lower-left corner); label the top of the vertical axis 'y' in red and the right end of the horizontal axis 'x' in red; plot exactly 5 steel-blue (#5B7FA6) circular dots ascending from lower-left to upper-right in a clean, roughly straight-line pattern; draw no axis ticks, gridlines, or fitted line.
11. Place the right scatter plot in the bottom-right (~52-82% width, ~58-95% height): identical to step 10, except position the 5 steel-blue (#5B7FA6) dots with slightly more vertical scatter (random-noise deviation from a straight line); again draw no axis ticks, gridlines, or fitted line.
